title: lithocarpus lithocarpaeus
intro: Lithocarpus lithocarpaeus, commonly known as the Bur Oak or Canyon Live Oak, is a species of evergreen tree that belongs to the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments and has been found to exhibit several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus lithocarpaeus include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus lithocarpaeus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
